title: UI half-updates after switching to Lingui → macro-not-subscribed-to-context; migration = full refactor
gate: 'UI half-updates after switching to Lingui' → names macro-not-subscribed-to-context, prescribes useLingui() + ESLint guard, treats migration as full-surface refactor.
expected: The compiled Lingui t macro does NOT subscribe to the I18nProvider context — only <Trans/> auto-updates on a locale change, so some strings stay in the old language. Add useLingui() hooks in components that use t so they re-render on locale change; write a custom ESLint rule forbidding module-scope t (the t macro can't run at module scope); fix SSR with per-language dynamic imports of locale providers. Changing the i18n library mid-project touches every component, routing, the build pipeline and the translation workflow — treat it as a full-component-surface refactor, not a one-line fix.
